README: The sound sheet. Read Topics/InThisTown/SOUND.md first. Times are cues and words, never seconds. Then: python3 scripts/sound.py build in-this-town-i-was-a-spy-for-the-villagers

sections.why: The village bell and square open the story in daylight.
The spy slips into the mansion and keeps under cover.
The drill reveals the pillagers' plan taking shape.
Hold a breath after the leader points at the bell and before the dawn threat.
The raid plan is revealed; the owner's track returns lower.
Back home, the warning becomes a village plan.
The pillagers make their sunrise charge.
The bell survives and the village answers with a cheer.
The spy carries the stiff-march joke toward its payoff.
Keep the final subscribe button grounded, never cheerful.
